name: input
title: Input
description: Solid text input component with invalid state styling hooks.

meta.customization: Use the mason-input class and data-invalid attribute for size, border, and validation-state styles.

parity.baseUi: Thin Mason input follows Base UI Input/Field direction for native input semantics, invalid/disabled data styling, ref/prop passthrough, and form participation. Gaps: field registration, validation lifecycle, filled/focused state data, clear button helpers, and app-level masking remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte TextField input anatomy when composed with Field. Gaps: no standalone Keystone TextField primitive for control registration, description/error ID ownership, or form reset behavior yet.
